does not prove human, device, or legal identity continuity

ROTATION_REVOKED

this predecessor signed this exact supplied rotation-revocation manifest through this historical boundary

## Key rotation revocation checkpoint lineage / local anti-rollback experiment
ROTATION_REVOCATION_LINEAGE_ADVANCE_ACCEPTABLE

does not prove globally newest/current rotation-revocation state
does not survive loss or replacement of retained local state
does not synchronize peers or choose a fork winner
